disclaimer: For information and entertainment only. Not betting advice.
method: Teams are ranked on recent-weighted efficiency (EPA per play, with garbage time removed), the same inputs the model uses. For defense, lower EPA allowed is better. vs_average is positive when a team is better than the league average. rank_change compares with the start of last week; positive means moved up. last_8 is the same stat over each team's last 8 games.

categories.label: Quarterback
categories.unit: career EPA per dropback, shrunk toward average
